transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I’m here because I’m absolutely certain there are serious problems and hidden manipulations in the data at work, but no one believes me and it’s starting to cost me my job. I've tried pointing out the discrepancies repeatedly, but they just brush it off and treat me like I'm the one making things up.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear, or seen things that others couldn't see?

No, I've never heard any strange voices or seen things that aren't there. My senses are perfectly fine, and the only things I'm seeing are the actual, physical manipulations in the spreadsheets they are trying to hide.
How long has this situation at work been going on, and do you feel like people in other areas of your life, such as your family or friends, are also trying to deceive or mistreat you?

The general strain and withdrawal at work have been going on for a little over two years, but I've been completely certain about this data tampering for just the last couple of months. No, my family and friends aren't trying to deceive me
Have you generally found it difficult to trust others or felt that people have hidden motives throughout your life, even before these issues at work began?

No, I don't recall having any lifelong trust issues or suspecting others of hidden motives before these recent events at work. I've generally just focused on my puzzles, my hobbies, and doing my job. This is a very specific issue with the water-use data that only started recently.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are being controlled or influenced by an outside force, or that others can read or hear your thoughts?

No, I have never felt anything like that; my thoughts are entirely my own and no one can read them. I don't have any issues with mind control or anything of that nature. My only concern is the actual, physical manipulation of the water-use data that is happening at my office.
Over the past two years, have you noticed a significant loss of interest or motivation in your usual hobbies, like your puzzles, or felt emotionally detached from things you used to enjoy?

Yes, I've completely lost interest in my puzzles, hiking with the Trailblazers, and star-gazing over the last couple of years. I just don't have the energy or motivation for anything anymore, and I feel quite emotionally flat. Most days I just sit in the living room staring at these spreadsheets, completely consumed by trying to fix the data issues.
Over the past two years, have you found it increasingly difficult to take care of daily responsibilities, such as personal hygiene, cooking, or keeping up with household chores?

Yes, I've completely neglected almost everything around the house lately. I just don't have the energy or interest to help with chores or daily tasks, and I spend almost all my time sitting at my desk or in the living room staring at those work printouts. It has left me completely unmotivated to do anything else, which has really isolated me at home.
During this time when you've felt low in energy, have you also been feeling persistently sad, down, or hopeless, or is it more of a general lack of emotion and feeling flat?

It is definitely more of a general lack of emotion and feeling flat rather than feeling sad or hopeless. I don't feel much of anything outside of my preoccupation with the work data, and I mostly just sit staring at printouts all day. I barely talk to my wife unless she asks me something directly, and I've completely stopped answering calls from my friends.
Have you or your wife noticed that your thoughts feel muddled or jumbled, or that you sometimes have difficulty organizing your words so that others can understand you?

No, I haven't noticed my thoughts being muddled or had any trouble organizing my words. While it's true I don't talk very much lately because I just don't have the energy or interest, when I do speak, my thoughts feel perfectly clear. I don't have any difficulty making sense to others when I have something to say.
Have you or your wife noticed any unusual physical behaviors, such as holding yourself in strange positions for a long time, or times when you became completely frozen and unable to move or speak?

No, I have never experienced anything like that. I don't hold strange physical positions and I have never frozen up or been unable to move. My physical movements are completely normal, even if I am spending a lot of my time just sitting at my desk.
How have your sleep patterns and appetite been over these past two years? Have you noticed any significant changes in them?
I haven't noticed any major changes in my sleep or appetite. Honestly, I'm not entirely sure because my focus has been completely consumed by the data issues at work.
Have you ever felt that things you see on TV, read on the internet, or hear on the radio have a special, hidden meaning meant specifically for you?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that at all. I don't find any hidden meanings in the TV or internet, as my focus is strictly on the manipulated water-use data at my office.

The presence of a clear delusion rules out Simple Schizophrenia (F20.6), and the severity of the negative symptoms rules out Delusional Disorder (F22.0). The presentation is best characterized as either Paranoid Schizophrenia (F20.0) or Undifferentiated Schizophrenia (F20.3) due to the prominent mix of negative symptoms and delusional beliefs without hallucinations.
